integrity: The exact bound follows from a finite-dimensional analytic proof. Reproducible finite rational checks are supplementary rather than substitutes for proof. Literature comparisons do not establish absolute novelty; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite totally ordered real vectors, positive quadratic fitting masses, and positive path-variation edge weights. No extension to arbitrary partial orders, nonquadratic losses, or continuum cones is claimed.
title: Exact concave-envelope stability of weighted isotonic regression in path variation
